description: A Software Accomplishment Summary (SAS) is produced, showing compliance with the PSAC.
name: accomplishment_summary

description: All life-cycle data configuration items are identified and placed under configuration management (baselined).
name: artifacts_baselined

description: Changes to baselined configuration items occur only through an approved change-control process.
name: changes_controlled

description: Source code is developed from, and traces to, the low-level requirements.
name: code_trace_to_llr

description: Source code is verified (review/analysis) for compliance with the low-level requirements and coding standards.
name: code_verified

description: Derived requirements (not traceable to a higher level) are provided to the system safety assessment process.
name: derived_requirements_to_safety

description: High-level requirements are developed from, and trace to, system requirements (bidirectional traceability).
name: hlr_trace_to_system

description: High-level requirements are verified for compliance, accuracy and consistency (review/analysis).
name: hlr_verified

description: Low-level requirements (software design) are developed from, and trace to, high-level requirements.
name: llr_trace_to_hlr

description: Low-level requirements / design are verified by review or analysis.
name: llr_verified

description: Software plans (PSAC, SDP, SVP, SCMP, SQAP) are established and approved before development of life-cycle data begins.
name: plans_before_development

description: Problem reports are tracked to closure — resolved, or deferred with recorded rationale.
name: problem_reports_closed

description: The Plan for Software Aspects of Certification (PSAC) is agreed with the certification authority before development proceeds.
name: psac_agreed

description: Software Quality Assurance assures that life-cycle processes and outputs comply with the approved plans and standards (conformity review).
name: sqa_conformity

description: Software requirements, design, and coding standards are defined before the corresponding life-cycle data is produced.
name: standards_defined

description: Structural coverage analysis confirms the achieved coverage appropriate to the DAL (MC/DC at A, decision at B, statement at C).
name: structural_coverage_achieved

description: Every test case traces to the requirement it verifies (bidirectional requirements-to-test traceability).
name: test_traces_to_requirement

description: Test cases are requirements-based, exercising the software against its requirements (normal and robustness).
name: tests_requirements_based

description: At DAL A/B, verification of the development outputs is performed with independence.
name: verification_independent
